summary: Iteration 29 verifies the DWM ($1,997) account-revert, DIY ($497) regression, and Before-You-Start UI removal. All 37 previously-updated backend tests (test_board_recruitment_proposal.py + test_batch_intake_e2e.py + test_iter28_account_verify.py) pass. Added test_iter29_dwm_revert.py (6 new tests) — all pass. Playwright verified /recruit/checkout no longer contains Before-You-Start heading, 4 cards, or the before-start-section data-testid, and that /recruit-your-board-yourself is unchanged (12 outcome headings, $497 price, MAKE PAYMENT CTA creates a 200 diy-checkout session).

minor.issue: For a *seeded-only* paid direct_board_recruitment_project session_id, the API returns 400 with detail 'We could not verify this purchase with Stripe' (Stripe verify happens BEFORE the offer_source check). Behavior is still correct security-wise (rejected, no entitlement granted, no purchases row), but reaching the specific 'not a Recruitment program purchase' string requires a real paid Stripe session with that offer_source metadata — not exercisable via seed alone. Existing test in test_board_recruitment_proposal.py already asserts status in (400, 402) which passes.

verifications.2_dwm_claim_security: PASS — paid seeded direct_project session rejected with 400; no entitlement, no purchases row (test_claim_paid_direct_project_is_rejected). Unpaid path returns 402 (test_iter28::test_claim_unpaid_session_returns_402).
verifications.3_dwm_intake_no_account: PASS — /api/board-recruitment-intake/context?session_id=... returns eligible:true; POST /api/board-recruitment-intake/submit (no auth) returns 201 with redirect_url=https://calendly.com/boardbuilder/recruitboard; row stored in db.board_recruitment_intakes with organization_name=TEST_DwmRevert Org.
verifications.4_diy_regression: PASS — diy-checkout success_url=/purchase/success?session_id=..., amount 49700; DIY intake redirect_url=/recruitment-start-here; module-tester@example.com login returns token + recruitment_self_guided entitlement (test_module_tester_login).
verifications.5_before_you_start_removed: PASS — /recruit/checkout HTML contains none of 'Before You Start' / 'This Is an Execution Program' / 'Complete the Steps in Order' / 'Use the Support Available to You' / 'You Make the Final Board Decisions'; no data-testid=before-start-section; page flows board-types-section -> checkout-commit-section; $497 pay button, terms checkbox, guarantee card, and testimonials preserved.
verifications.6_recruit_yourself_unchanged: PASS — /recruit-your-board-yourself loads, no Before-You-Start, $497 price, MAKE PAYMENT CTA triggers POST /api/payments/diy-checkout -> 200 with checkout_url + session_id, 12 outcome headings in walk-away section, money-back guarantee text present, testimonials present.
verifications.7_pytest_all_pass: PASS — 37 tests across the three requested files + 6 new iter29 tests = 43 passing.

critical_code_review_comments: member_routes.claim_recruitment_purchase orders Stripe verification BEFORE the offer_source check. If Stripe is ever unreachable or the session was created purely locally (seed/replay), buyers see a generic 'could not verify with Stripe' error even when the underlying purchase is not a Recruitment program purchase at all. Consider inspecting the local payment_transactions row first when metadata is already known, then fall through to Stripe for authoritative verification — improves clarity and testability.
test_credentials: Admin rooney@nonprofitboardbuilder.com (not needed this round); module-tester@example.com / ModuleTest123! login verified.
seed_data_creation: All seed rows (TEST_DwmRevert Org intake, seeded paid payment_transactions, transient test members test_iter29_/test_acct_/test_brp_) were cleaned up. module-tester account preserved. Exactly ONE DWM intake submit executed (owner-notification path) with TEST_DwmRevert Org / test_dwm_revert@example.com per instructions.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend Stripe key must be sourced from /app/backend/.env with 'set -a && source .env && set +a' — using cut -d= truncates the key because it contains '=' padding-like chars. All three original suites + new iter29 suite are now the regression baseline for the reverted DWM (no-account) flow.
